task_text: Reciprocal two-cup air relay: A ball is thrown high into the air when the episode starts and comes down near the left Panda. The left arm catches it in its cup and throws it through the air to the right arm, whose cup must have moved from its start to catch it. The right arm carries the ball to a second transfer region and throws it back. The left arm catches it again and delivers it into an open box that slides back and forth along a rail, where the ball must settle while the box is moving. Phases, in order: left_initial_catch: panda-0's cup catches the ball. First the ball flies free (touching nothing) for at least 25 ms. It then enters the cup from above: its centre crosses downwards through the plane `tool_height` + `radius` = 0.046 m above the cup floor (cup frame) while within `tool_half` - `radius` = 0.042 m of the cup centre in both x and y of the cup frame. After that entry the ball stays in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. In the cup frame: |x| and |y| < `tool_half` - 0.45 x `radius` = 0.0519 m; centre between `radius` - 4 mm = 0.014 m and `tool_height` - 0.12 x `radius` = 0.02584 m above the floor; touched by that cup within the last 25 ms; speed relative to the cup < 0.09 m/s.; left_to_right_flight: The ball has touched nothing for more than 0.045 s (counted within this phase) and its centre is above z = 0.30 m.; right_catch: panda-1's cup catches the ball by the same test as left_initial_catch (a fresh entry from above after at least 25 ms of free flight, then retention for 0.18 s without interruption). At a step where this catch holds, the right cup's tool frame is more than 0.04 m (3-D distance) from its start position (0.19, 0.18, 0.22).; second_region: panda-1's tool frame is within 0.035 m of (0.13, 0.15, 0.24) while the ball is retained in the right cup. Retention uses the same test as above but needs no hold time.; right_to_left_flight: The ball has touched nothing for more than 0.045 s (counted within this phase) and its centre is above z = 0.31 m.; left_catch_and_deliver: panda-0's cup first catches the ball again (fresh entry from above after at least 25 ms of free flight, then retention for 0.18 s, as in left_initial_catch). After that catch is registered, the ball rests in the cart. In the cart's frame: |x| and |y| < 0.075 - 0.45 x `radius` = 0.0669 m; centre between 0.014 m and 0.06 - 0.12 x `radius` = 0.05784 m above the cart floor; touched by the cart within the last 25 ms; speed relative to the cart < 0.09 m/s. At the same time the ball does not touch the left cup and the cart moves faster than 0.02 m/s, for 0.7 s without interruption. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Second transfer region: the point (0.13, 0.15, 0.24) for panda-1's tool frame, radius 0.035 m. Flight heights: ball centre above z = 0.30 m (left to right) and z = 0.31 m (right to left). Right-cup relocation: more than 0.04 m from its start (0.19, 0.18, 0.22) at the right catch.
